decisions.reason: The no-extra-text instruction is limited to filling the identified empty spaces with supplied images; it does not revoke the separate use of blurbs or quotes to break up overly long text.
The fill-content restriction does not change author names, author photographs, their presentation, or their source.
The instruction to use images rather than extra text for specific empty spaces does not change the selected typeface or weight treatment.
The page-specific fill-content decision does not modify the magazine's general visual style, branding reference, or red-color rule.

The candidate already has a message-145 MODIFY capturing the separate instruction to send the final PDF to the client for Heyzine upload; the whitespace decision requires no additional change to this Requirement.
Using only supplied images to fill article-ending spaces does not change the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy rule.
The source decision changes permitted fill content, not article order, page placement, or the flat-plan basis.

The candidate already has a complete message-145 MODIFY for the separate Heyzine white-label, account-owner, and upload-responsibility decision; the whitespace restriction adds no hosting-state change.
Selecting supplied images as the only fill content does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The source does not add or remove any required article or tribute page.
The instruction specifies images rather than extra text for the affected article spaces and does not change advertisement rendering quality.
The source contains no change to the launch deadline or required live-launch state.
